Minimal & Fast Build System

Usage: ando [command] [options]

Commands:
  run               Run the build script (default command)
  verify            Check build script for errors without executing
  commit            Commit all changes with AI-generated message
  bump [type]       Bump version in all projects (patch|minor|major)
  docs              Update documentation using Claude
  release [type]    Interactive release workflow (patch|minor|major)
  ship [type]       Ship without publish (commit, bump, docs, push)
  clean             Remove artifacts, temp files, and containers
  help, -h, --help  Show this help
  -v, --version     Show version number

Run Options:
  -f, --file <file>   Use specific build file instead of build.csando
  -p, --profile <name>
                      Activate build profiles (comma-separated for multiple)
                      Example: -p release or -p publish,release
  --read-env          Load env file without prompting (also applies to sub-builds)
  --no-env            Do not load the env file for this run (even with readEnv in ando.config)
  --verbosity <level> Set output verbosity: quiet|minimal|normal|detailed
  --no-color          Disable colored output (also respects NO_COLOR env var)
  --cold              Always create fresh container (ignore warm container)
  --image <image>     Use custom Docker image instead of default/script-defined
  --dind              Mount Docker socket for Docker-in-Docker operations
  --ref <commit|tag>  Build that commit from a clean temporary checkout, not the working tree
  --yes               Accept every Ando.Confirm prompt (for non-interactive runs)
  --dry-run           Evaluate the script and print the step tree without running anything
                      (unknown options are rejected, so a typo never starts a real run)

Release Options:
  patch               Bump patch version (default): 1.0.0 -> 1.0.1
  minor               Bump minor v
